title: Llyn Sarnau Walk Route

images.title: Terry Hughes / Reservoir West of Llyn Sarnau
images.caption: Reservoir West of Llyn Sarnau

description: This circular walk explores the area around Llyn Sarnau in the Gwydyr Forest. On the way there are some peaceful woodland trails and lovely views over the lake to the surrounding woodland. The area also has a rich history of lead and zinc mining, featuring remnants such as old engine houses, waste tips, and covered mine shafts. Several historic mine sites, including Sarnau, Gorlan, Llanrwst, and All-wen Lead Mines, are located near Llyn Sarnau. Visitors can explore areas like the Cyffty Mine trail, which details mining operations and history, while being advised to stay on marked paths due to unprotected drops and old buildings.To continue your lakeside walking in the area head north to visitLlyn Geirionydd. You could also visit the popular village ofBetws y Coedfor refreshments and more walking ideas.
